question: Compare Zoom and Microsoft Teams on enterprise video conferencing

findings.claim: Zoom describes its video conferencing programme.
findings.evidence: Zoom states that its video conferencing programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
findings.title: Zoom platform overview

findings.claim: Microsoft Teams describes its video conferencing programme.
findings.evidence: Microsoft Teams states that its video conferencing programme is organised around partner platforms.
findings.title: Microsoft Teams platform overview

findings.evidence: Both Zoom and Microsoft Teams report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
findings.title: Partnership summary

findings.claim: An analyst note compares the two approaches.
findings.evidence: The note contrasts Zoom's in-house delivery with Microsoft Teams's partner-led model.
findings.title: Analyst note

findings.claim: Zoom discloses investment in video conferencing capability.
findings.evidence: Zoom discloses continued investment in video conferencing training and certification.
findings.title: Zoom investment disclosure

findings.claim: Microsoft Teams discloses investment in video conferencing capability.
findings.evidence: Microsoft Teams discloses continued investment in video conferencing delivery centres.
findings.title: Microsoft Teams investment disclosure

sections.heading: How Zoom and Microsoft Teams organise video conferencing
sections.body: Zoom runs video conferencing through a dedicated unit, while Microsoft Teams organises the same work around partner platforms. The two structures lead to different delivery models.

sections.heading: Partnerships and investment
sections.body: Both Zoom and Microsoft Teams report platform partnerships, and both disclose continued investment in video conferencing capability, though in different places.

claims.text: Zoom delivers video conferencing work through a dedicated business unit.
Microsoft Teams organises video conferencing work around partner platforms.
Both Zoom and Microsoft Teams report multi-year platform partnerships.
Zoom and Microsoft Teams both disclose continued video conferencing investment.

verdicts.quote: Zoom states that its video conferencing programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
Microsoft Teams states that its video conferencing programme is organised around partner platforms.
Both Zoom and Microsoft Teams report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
Zoom discloses continued investment in video conferencing training and certification.
